description: WRITE tool — adds a competitor app under a Sonar product so its keywords and rankings get tracked alongside the product's own app. The product must already have its own app linked in the same store as the competitor. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "us"). Optional — defaults server-side.

product_id.description: Sonar product UUID (from sonar_create_product). NOT a store id.

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier of the COMPETITOR app to track. iOS: numeric track ID. Android: package name.

name: sonar_track_competitor
title: Track Competitor
